name: @moments/extension
description: Chrome MV3 extension: one hotkey saves a YouTube timestamp to Moments.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run icons && vite build && vite build --config vite.config.content.ts
scripts.dev: npm run icons && concurrently -k -n main,content -c blue,magenta "vite build --watch" "vite build --config vite.config.content.ts --watch"
scripts.zip: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../moments-extension.zip . && echo 'wrote packages/extension/moments-extension.zip'
